notes.title: 体験版からの追加箇所
notes.notes:
I submitted the build to Valve.
The version has been upgraded from the trial version.
[Additions and changes from the trial version]
・ Major revision of stage visuals
・ Addition of daytime stage
・ Female characters can be selected.
・ Addition of fishing attack.
・ Addition of sliding.
・ Addition of intermediate points.
・ Added escape function to the map
・ Correct the range of gunshots
・ The number of cans in the trash can has become finite.
・ Many other adjustments

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38773460/d10c45cbb0e3adbc0fc086789730e6ae328cfd96.png[/img]
